name: Rating Stars
summary: Canonical passive half-step rating projection with one named star image, default or large presentation, shape-distinct states, and optional localized review-count text.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Ordinary inline layout root with no widget, image, group, live-region, or interactive semantics.

anatomy.name: stars
anatomy.description: Single named image representing the complete target-supplied rating value and scale.

anatomy.name: star
anatomy.description: Repeated decorative full, half, or empty glyph/SVG hidden from assistive technology.

anatomy.name: count
anatomy.description: Optional complete localized review-count text that remains independently readable outside the star image.

anatomy.name: halfFill
anatomy.description: Private inline-start half-fill layer for text-glyph anatomy; target SVGs may supply equivalent partial geometry.

sizes.name: lg
sizes.description: Large 1.5rem star presentation migrated from deprecated V2 Star Rating.

states.name: default
states.description: Passive root and default outlined empty-star anatomy.

states.name: filled
states.description: Solid full-star visual state supplied by the target adapter.

states.name: half
states.description: Outlined star plus inline-start partial fill supplied by target SVG or private text-glyph composition.

behavior.name: passiveRoot
behavior.description: The root does not receive focus, expose interaction, announce updates, or override the semantics of its independently readable count.

behavior.name: ratingImage
behavior.description: The star sequence is exposed once as one localized image name containing the target-supplied value and scale.

behavior.name: decorativeStars
behavior.description: Individual visual stars are decorative and never announced as five redundant images or characters.

behavior.name: shapeDistinctStates
behavior.description: Full, half, and empty stars use solid, partial-fill, and outline form in addition to color so rating meaning survives monochrome and forced colors.

behavior.name: reviewCount
behavior.description: Optional count is complete localized ordinary text, such as 24 reviews, and is omitted when not supplied.

behavior.name: adapterOwnedProjection
behavior.description: The target resolves raw provider data, scale, rounding, missing data and localized count before supplying a valid half-step value; neutral Web performs no browser calculation or normalization.

behavior.name: strictComposition
behavior.description: A non-empty localized accessibleLabel and a finite 0..5 value aligned to 0.5 are required; invalid required composition emits no Rating root.

properties.name: ratingValue
properties.description: Target-supplied normalized half-step rating represented by the decorative stars; Rating does not calculate, normalize, or round provider data.

properties.name: accessibleLabel
properties.description: Complete localized text alternative containing the target-supplied rating value and scale; it must agree with the visual star anatomy.

properties.name: reviewCount
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the count element when no complete localized review-count text is supplied.
properties.description: Optional complete localized visible count text, including its review noun rather than punctuation or a raw number alone.

properties.name: size
properties.description: Default or large visual presentation; size does not change semantics or content.

accessibility: Expose the complete rating value and scale once on the star image; do not expose every decorative star separately.
Keep optional review-count text independently readable outside the star image and include a localized review noun.
Use solid, partial-fill, and outline form in addition to color for full, half, and empty states.
Require a valid target-normalized half-step value and a complete localized accessible label that agrees with the visual sequence.
Keep the component passive and unfocusable; use Star Input for interactive value entry.
Do not add live-region semantics; the consuming target owns any dynamic rating/count announcement.

web.notes: Canonical passive anatomy, default/large geometry, and visual states are implemented by components/css/primitives.css; each target supplies the truthful sequence with no neutral browser runtime.

shopify.notes: Dedicated Liquid maps Shopify Rating metadata and localized count text without owning aggregation or review-provider policy.
